_comment: CraftBench substrate-level manifest describing which submission paths an agent is allowed to write. Path-prefix matching is applied to POSIX-normalized, repo-relative paths after symlink resolution. A submission file must match at least one 'writable' prefix AND must not match any 'deny' prefix. Both lists are evaluated against directories and files alike. See tools/verify-single/sandbox.py. Content/ carve-out (2026-06-01): Content/Tasks/ is writable so asset-deliverable tasks (materials, widgets, blueprints) can be submitted under Content/Tasks/<task_id>/; the rest of Content/ stays denied (allowlist-miss), with Content/Maps/ denied explicitly for defense-in-depth.
_asset_writable_comment: BP-deliverable allowance (2026-06-05): ASSET files (.uasset/.umap) under these prefixes are accepted by --capture-assets even though they are OUTSIDE the strict 'writable' source prefixes. Aura's bp_agent/material_agent/audio_agent author assets under Content/Blueprints/, Content/Abilities/, Content/Generated_Materials/, and Content/Generated_Audio/ (not only Content/Tasks/), so those must be captured + graded — observed live on the realistic-collectible-coin run (BP_CollectibleCoin under Content/Blueprints/, M_GoldenCoin under Content/Generated_Materials/, SFX_CoinPickup under Content/Generated_Audio/). 'deny' still wins — Content/Maps/ (verifier-owned task maps) stays rejected. This list governs ASSET files only; non-asset files outside 'writable' remain rejected, so the allowance only widens which generated-asset folders are gradeable, never which source/config paths an agent may write.
